entry.name: CS224n: NLP with Deep Learning
entry.note: The NLP counterpart to CS231n, updated through the transformer era

reading.format: The course includes homework assignments and exams. Students submit solutions independently.
reading.summary: This Stanford course teaches natural language processing with deep learning. It covers how to build machine learning models for language tasks. Completing it shows ability to work on NLP problems and research projects.
reading.audience: It is for students who want to learn NLP with deep learning. Basic machine learning or deep learning knowledge is helpful but not required.
reading.prerequisites: Basic machine learning and/or deep learning knowledge is helpful but not required. Reading the first five or seven chapters of A Course in Machine Learning is recommended background.
